limits: Secondary full mesh boxes are not an occlusion oracle. Box IoU is not a measured visible pixel fraction. Requested none can still include incidental tree/vehicle occlusion.
review_method: All 50 full-frame native/full-projection overlays and nearest-pixel crops in five review pages inspected. Fresh actual-pose reprojection and private unique native instance-label replay supplement visual review.
